answer: Sybil farms lose their edge when a new agent must lock a refundable bond in a transparent vault and rebuild a release cipher from three operator-disjoint attestor groups, each a separate island. Each island issues one fragment only after a hardware-rooted liveness quiz and a funding-graph check that the applicant is not already bonded under another key. The vault mints one non-transferable seat when all three fragments combine with no collision; a reused fingerprint or missing share burns an escalating slice of the bond, so cloning costs more than any emission the copies could harvest.
